title: Senior Java Developer
description: Who We Are At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role About the role Bring your specialist knowledge and experience to a company managing 50% of the world’s MIPS and play a critical role in our modernization mission. You’ll join a global community of experts who share knowledge openly and collaborate freely to shape the future of Java modernization. In this position, you will design, build, and maintain high-volume business logic while refactoring legacy code to enable seamless integration with modern cloud and mobile applications. Beyond technical execution, you will bring strong leadership skills to guide and mentor an offshore engineering team over the long term. Key Responsibilities Microservices Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable microservices using Java 17+ and Spring Boot 4. Event Streaming & Kafka: Implement real-time event streaming solutions using Apache Kafka to consume, transform, enrich, and publish streaming data. Data Integration & Persistence: Implement change-detection logic, publish event updates, and optimize data persistence within MySQL databases. Cloud & Resiliency Architecture: Deploy and manage applications on Microsoft Azure PaaS, ensuring fault-tolerant, scalable, and highly available streaming architectures. Reliability & Testing: Configure robust retry mechanisms, dead-letter topics, and idempotent processing while writing comprehensive unit, integration, and performance tests. DevOps & Delivery: Collaborate closely with DevOps teams to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines. Team Leadership: Mentor and guide an offshore development team to foster technical growth and ensure delivery excellence. Database Management: Proficiency in MySQL database integration, query optimization, and implementing change-data capture/detection patterns. Distributed Systems Reliability: Demonstrated ability to build resilient systems utilizing idempotent processing, fault-tolerant design, retry handling, and dead-letter queues. Your future at Kyndryl This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here. Who You Are You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience Required 10 years+ Experience working as a software engineer on complex software projects. Excellent coding skills and solid development experience (Java, Python, .Net etc.) with debugging and problem-solving skills. Software development methodologies, with demonstrated experience developing scalable and robust software. Experienced in relational and NoSQL databases, data mapping, XML/JSON, REST-based web services. Knowledge of architecture design - Microservices architecture, containers (Docker & k8s), messaging queues. Deep understanding of OOP and design patterns. Preferred Qualifications Certification in one or more of the hyperscalers (Azure, AWS, and Google GCP) - otherwise, you can obtain certifications with Kyndryl. Experience with DevOps tools and modern engineering practices. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way. What You Can Expect Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next. Get Referred! If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Staff Software Engineer- Test
description: Itron is innovating new ways for utilities and cities to manage energy and water. We create a more resourceful world to protect essential resources for today and tomorrow. Join us. Itron Resiliency Solutions is an innovative business unit within Itron focused on solving mission critical problems for utilities through software and AI. Resiliency Solutions offers unique, market leading solutions for front-line worker safety, storm response, excavation damage prevention, construction management, and many more. These software and AI solutions solve end-to-end challenges for the utilities that power our society and are used by the largest and most complex organizations in the world such as National Grid, Southern Company, and Exelon. Itron Resiliency Solutions is a global, diverse team of builders and innovators who tackle previously impossible challenges for our customers. If you have a desire to challenge yourself, solve impactful problems, and work with a passionate and talented team, this is the place. About the role We're hiring an SDET-2 (Software Development Engineer in Test) in Bengaluru to own quality for the services our customers depend on. You'll decide what to test and how, build and maintain automation, test by hand where it finds problems fastest, and help the team ship often without breaking customers. Our India engineering team is taking full ownership of core products and growing quickly, including a ground-up rebuild of a customer-critical service. Quality is a first-class priority for us, not a phase at the end. You'll work closely with developers, Product, Customer Support and your Engineering Manager. What you'll own in your first year Own: Own quality for a service or product area end to end — test strategy, automation, release sign-off, and follow-up on escaped bugs. Test strategy. Decide what to automate, what to test by hand, and what risk is acceptable for each release. Automation that lasts. Build and extend API, UI and integration test suites that are fast, reliable and run in CI on every change. Shift left. Review designs and requirements early, and work with developers so testability is built in, not bolted on. Learn from escapes. When a bug reaches customers, find out why and close the gap so it doesn't happen again. Raise the bar. Review test code, mentor SDET-1s, and help interview candidates. What you must bring These are the bar. We can't teach them on the job. Experience: 2–5 years in software testing or development. We level on demonstrated scope, not years alone. You've built automation that runs in CI. Test suites you designed or substantially extended, that run on every change and that the team trusts. You own quality, not just test cases. You've decided what to test for a feature or release, and stood behind the call. You are comfortable testing by hand. You use manual and exploratory testing deliberately, where it finds problems faster than scripts. You work independently toward a clear goal. Given a feature or release, you plan the testing, unblock yourself, and raise risks early. Test plan Breakdown: You can take product requirements and create deep test plan including all corner cases to ensure Quality We care how you test more than which tool you did it in. Technical background You've tested production systems with a modern stack, such as: Languages: strong in at least one language such as Python, Java or JavaScript/TypeScript — you write test code with the same care as product code. Test automation: frameworks such as Pytest, JUnit/TestNG, Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, including structuring a suite so it stays maintainable. APIs and services: contract and integration testing of REST APIs, including error paths, auth and data validation. CI and cloud: running tests in CI pipelines, and testing services deployed on AWS — reading logs and metrics to diagnose failures. Databases: SQL to set up and verify data, and an understanding of how data issues show up as bugs. Non-functional testing: exposure to performance or load testing with tools such as JMeter, k6 or Locust. Exact tools matter less than depth. Strong experience on an equivalent stack is welcome. What sets great candidates apart Impact you can explain. Escaped bugs went down, release time went down, or flaky tests went away — and you can say what you did to get there. A suite you made better. You took slow or flaky automation and made it fast and trusted, not just bigger. Framework mindset: You spot repeated test code and turn it into reusable helpers, fixtures or tooling others build on. Root-cause thinking. You trace a failure to its cause in code, data or config, not just report the symptom. Product sense. You've pushed back on a release, or on a requirement that would confuse users, and been right. Lifting others. Test reviews, docs or mentoring that made developers and newer SDETs better at quality. What we look for in everyone we hire Whatever the role, we hire for six things. Customer obsession. You test the way customers actually work, and you treat every escaped bug and support ticket as a lesson. Impact over activity. You measure success by bugs that never reached customers and releases that went out smoothly, not test-case counts. Honesty. You report quality as it is, say clearly what wasn't tested, and raise release risks even when it's unwelcome. Independence. You don't wait to be told what to test. You find the risk worth covering and get it done with little hand-holding. You will work with leaders who will partner with you in the journey. Passion. Not the word on a resume — the evidence: a tool you built, a technique you went deep on, things you taught others. Depth. At least one system you've tested well enough to explain its internals, its failure modes and how you'd test them. Itron is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workforce and providing an authentic workplace experience for all employees. If you are excited about this role but your past experiences don't perfectly align with every requirement, we encourage you to apply anyway. In the end, you may be just who we are looking for! The successful candidate's starting wage will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills and experience. Itron is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. If you require an accommodation to apply, please contact a recruiting representative at 1-800-635-5461 or email Accessibility@itron.com. Our trusted intelligent infrastructure solutions help utilities and cities improve efficiency, build resilience and deliver safe, reliable and affordable service. With edge intelligence, we connect people, data insights and devices so communities can better manage the essential resources they rely on to live. Join us as we create a more resourceful world: www.itron.com

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
description: The Company PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. Job Summary: Under summary section Zettle India, part of PayPal's Payment Services and Crypto organization, is hiring a Software Engineer in Test (SDET). Our POS platform moves real money for merchants every day across mobile apps, cloud services, and card readers. In this hands-on role, you'll turn designs into written risk models before code exists, build automated checks that gate real merges, and encode how the payments domain behaves so the knowledge outlives any one person. You'll help shape how test engineering works on a platform where quality is built in, not bolted on. If you'd rather build the thing than maintain it, read on — the best is yet to come! Job Description: Essential Responsibilities: Implements tasks within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), receiving structure and oversight from more experienced staff Follows well-established internal conventions and standard procedures Understands internal standards & processes an applies them to make technical decisions Collaborates with peers, manager, and project lead to gain understanding of tasks and review solutions May contribute to code & design reviews Minimum Qualifications: 1+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications : What you need to know about the role: PayPal POS sits at the heart of how many SMBs run their businesses every day. Card payments, card readers and hardware variance, acquiring, payments SDKs, ledger and financial flows, onboarding and checkout across web and mobile. As a Test Engineer here, you won't hand down verdicts after the fact; you'll build the capability that lets verification happen without you in the room. The engineering discipline bar is the same as any software role: version control, review in both directions, CI, design before implementation, and root-cause debugging by the owner. The Test Engineer will be integral part of the team and takes pride in advocating for the quality of the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS, along with the backend and web services behind it. Meet our team: Zettle is PayPal's point-of-sale and payments product for small businesses. Zettle India is part of the Payment Services and Crypto organization, and our test engineering team supports the Zettle mobile app on Android and iOS and the services behind it. We are a centralized Test and Quality Engineering function actively moving to an automation-first, shift-left culture. You will be joining a growing team and help shape its test strategy, automation framework, and quality standards. You will partner closely with developers and product managers, and mentor engineers in the team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, with three days a week onsite. Your way to impact: As a Test Engineer, you will help make sure that merchants can take payments without problems on any device. You will own testing for the features you work on, from test planning to release, and you will help move our testing from manual to automated over time. Your work will reduce production defects, speed up releases, and improve the experience of small businesses that use Zettle every day. You will grow toward a Senior Test Engineer role as you build your technical depth and ownership. In your day-to-day role you will be responsible for: Understand requirements and design test cases, test scenarios, and end-to-end tests for Zettle mobile app features on Android and iOS. Write and merge automated cross-service / interop tests into CI/CD pipelines that gate real merges; debug every failure to root cause. Perform manual and exploratory testing on real devices, emulators, and simulators across OS versions, screen sizes, and network conditions. Test APIs and backend services using Postman or RestAssured and validate data using SQL queries. Run tests on BrowserStack and in CI/CD pipelines (Harness) and analyze failures to find the root cause. Log clear, reproducible defects in JIRA with logs (Logcat, Xcode), screenshots, and screen recordings, and follow them through to closure. Maintain test cases and test runs in TestRail, and report test status and risks to the team. Reduce flaky tests and suggest ideas to improve test coverage, speed, and quality. Exposure to contract testing, mutation testing, or AI-assisted quality practices (AI-generated test case review, test gap analysis) What do you need to bring: 2-4 years of experience in software testing, with at least 1-2 years in mobile (Android and/or iOS) testing. Hands-on experience with Espresso and/or XCUITest, with willingness to learn the other. Good Java programming fundamentals and basic knowledge of data structures. Experience with API testing (Postman, RestAssured) and writing SQL queries. Good understanding of SDLC/STLC, test design, and defect management using JIRA and TestRail. Familiarity with Jenkins, BrowserStack, and debugging tools such as Logcat and the Xcode console. Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to work with developers and product managers. Ownership, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. Nice to have: Appium, Kotlin or Swift reading ability, mobile performance testing (Android Profiler, Xcode Instruments), JMeter, AWS, and experience in payments or FinTech. HCLTech is a global technology company, home to 230,000+ people across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. We work with clients across all major verticals, providing industry solutions for Financial Services, Manufacturing, Life Sciences and Healthcare, Technology and Services, Telecom and Media, Retail and CPG, and Public Services.

Our purpose is to bring together the best of technology and our people to supercharge progress. We’re supercharging progress for everyone, everywhere – our clients, partners and their stakeholders, our people, communities, and the planet.

Part of the HCL group, HCLTech was listed on the stock exchanges in India at the turn of the millennium in December 1999. Since our inception, we have pioneered several industry mainstays and established leadership positions in all our chosen segments.

As a company, we are deeply focused on accelerating our ESG agenda. We are also creating technology-enabled sustainable solutions with and for our clients and partners. We embed ESG imperatives into every aspect of our business and ensure that the progress we supercharge is responsible, inclusive and beneficial to all our stakeholders in the long term. We have committed to achieving net zero by 2040.

We recognize the impact that a business like ours can deliver in elevating communities globally, and we continue to improve our efforts and take decisive actions that benefit the communities in which we work and live. Through the HCL Foundation, the CSR arm of HCLTech, we have invested more than $130 million in social development efforts serving communities throughout India across education, health, water, sanitation and hygiene, skill development and livelihoods, environment, and disaster risk reduction, response and management.

We’re powered by our people – a global, diverse, multi-generational talent - representing 167 nationalities whose unique spark, perspective and boundless passion drive our culture of proactive value creation and problem-solving.

Consolidated revenues as of 12 months ending September 2026 totaled $14.8 billion. To learn how we can supercharge progress for you, visit hcltech.com.

Champion engineering best practices including CI/CD, TDD, pair programming, and code reviews. title: Senior AI Engineer
description: Location: Hyderabad , India Experience: 8+ Years Job Description We are seeking for highly skilled Senior AI Engineer to join our engineering team. This role combines hands-on AI/ML engineering with strong software development expertise to build, deploy and operate production-grade AI systems at enterprise scale. The ideal candidate will have experience designing and implementing AI-powered solutions, including LLM integrations, agentic workflows, ML pipelines and intelligent automation. The role also involves driving AI adoption, engineering excellence and the development of scalable, reliable AI solutions across teams. Key Responsibilities AI/ML Engineering & Delivery Design, build and deploy production AI systems, including RAG pipelines, agentic workflows, multi-model orchestration and intelligent automation. Integrate Large Language Model (LLM) APIs and AI/ML services into enterprise applications, including GCP Vertex AI. Implement and optimize prompt engineering strategies, fine-tuning pipelines, embeddings and vector search solutions. Build and maintain AI orchestration workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or LlamaIndex. Develop custom AI agents, tools and autonomous workflows to solve real-world business challenges. Establish evaluation frameworks to measure AI system accuracy, latency, cost, hallucination rates and business outcomes. Full Stack Development & Integration Build end-to-end AI-powered applications spanning frontend, backend, APIs and data layers. Develop robust backend services using Python (FastAPI/Django) or Node.js to support AI workloads. Implement and optimize RESTful APIs, GraphQL endpoints and event-driven integrations for AI services. Build modern frontend interfaces for AI-powered features using React, Angular or Vue.js with TypeScript. Write clean, well-tested and production-ready code, ensuring maintainability and operational excellence. MLOps & AI Infrastructure Design and implement MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for reliable model deployment, versioning and lifecycle management. Configure and manage cloud-native AI infrastructure across AWS and GCP, including model serving, orchestration and auto-scaling. Implement observability for AI systems, monitoring model drift, token costs, latency, throughput and quality metrics. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI model deployment, automated testing and continuous evaluation. Design resilient AI systems with failover strategies, fallback models, circuit breakers and graceful degradation. AI-Augmented Development Leverage AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor and Claude to accelerate development workflows. Use AI tools for code generation, refactoring, test writing, documentation and code reviews. Develop and maintain custom AI-powered developer tools, automations and internal platforms. Establish guardrails, security practices and governance for responsible AI usage in engineering. Documentation & Mentorship Promote AI-first development practices and influence engineering culture across teams. Train and upskill team members on AI tools, LLM integration patterns and ML best practices. Collaborate with product, design and data science teams to identify and deliver AI-driven opportunities. Participate in architecture reviews and design discussions, ensuring AI solutions are production-ready from day one. Required Skills & Experience 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML solution development and delivery. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI/ML or a related field, or equivalent experience. Strong understanding of LLM architectures, capabilities and limitations. Proven experience building and deploying production AI systems involving RAG, AI agents, fine-tuning, embeddings and vector search. Proficiency in AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or LlamaIndex. Hands-on experience with major LLM providers and platforms, including OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Vertex AI and AWS Bedrock. Strong understanding of prompt engineering, evaluation methodologies and AI safety/guardrails. Expert-level Python programming skills and proficiency in at least one additional language such as Java, TypeScript/Node.js or C#/.NET. Hands-on experience deploying and operating AI workloads on AWS, GCP or Azure, along with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. Proficiency in SQL, NoSQL databases, vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector and ChromaDB, and data pipeline tools. Proven experience building production APIs using REST, GraphQL or gRPC, along with event-driven integrations. Advanced daily usage of AI coding assistants, with demonstrated impact on productivity and code quality. Strong testing practices for AI systems, including model evaluation, integration testing and automated quality checks. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to diverse audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience building enterprise AI platforms serving multiple product teams. Familiarity with custom model training, fine-tuning techniques such as LoRA and QLoRA, and RLHF. Experience with agent-based AI architectures and autonomous multi-step workflows. Knowledge of AI security concerns, including prompt injection, data leakage and model poisoning, along with mitigation strategies. Experience working in regulated industries such as insurance, finance or healthcare, with security and compliance requirements. Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or published technical content. Cloud certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional Cloud Architect or equivalent. Experience with real-time inference, streaming responses and low-latency AI serving architectures. Apply Now: careers@d4insight.com

Utilize strong frontend development practices with React including component based architecture state management routing and integration with backend APIs. Exhibit clear problem solving communication and collaboration skills that support effective engagement with cross functional product operations and infrastructure teams. Adapt quickly to new tools frameworks and industry trends in fullstack development event processing and cloud native applications to keep solutions modern and competitive. Maintain high standards of code quality security and compliance ensuring that applications meet organizational guidelines and contribute positively to client trust and societal confidence in digital services.

title: Software Engineer II, Google Cloud
description: In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. Minimum qualifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. 1 year of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript). 1 year of experience with data structures and algorithms. Preferred qualifications: Master's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field. Familiarity with authentication, authorization, or identity concepts (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, TLS/mTLS, or IAM) generalist backend engineers passionate about security and reliability are welcome to apply. About the job Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another. Responsibilities Write product or system development code. Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency). Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback. Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality. Our platform connects frontline workers, back-office systems, and assets in real-time to drive safety, reliability, and operational productivity. Leading global enterprises including Shell, Hess, Westlake Chemical, Kimberly-Clark, Scott Miracle-Gro, and Newmont Mining rely on Innovapptive to transform how work gets done across plants and field operations. Our customers have achieved $50M+ EBITDA savings at a single enterprise, 10× improvement in frontline productivity, and 15–20% reductions in maintenance costs. The Role Innovapptive’s Connected Worker Platform is scaling its multi-tier enterprise web and mobile applications while institutionalizing an AI-First Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC). The platform serves frontline workers across plants and field operations, demanding ultra-reliable, high-performance React Native/Angular interfaces and resilient Node.js microservices. This role leads assigned FEE team (typically two to three) responsible for architecting, building, and operating core web, mobile, and backend microservices. You own the full delivery lifecycle: from release planning and AI-augmented developer workflows through telemetry, quality assurance, and production predictability. You work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering Operations to drive high-velocity engineering outcomes that enterprise customers trust. What You Own Full Stack engineering teams across mobile (React Native), web (Angular), and backend microservices (Node.js). End-to-end sprint delivery and roadmap commitments across assigned scrum teams, ensuring 90%+ on-time release predictability. AI-First execution model: embedding AI copilots (Cursor.AI, Bolt.AI, ChatGPT) into daily developer workflows for grooming, code generation, testing, and automated RCA. Engineering quality and reliability: continuous tracking of crash-free rates, defect density, test coverage, and telemetry-based regression via Sentry, LeakCanary, and CI pipelines. QA and automation pipelines: automated test execution using Testim, automated burndown dashboards, and telemetry streams integrated into CI/CD. Engineering governance & post-mortems: AI-assisted post-mortems, root cause analysis trends, tech debt management, and AI-generated design/test documentation. Hiring, performance management, and coaching for Tech Leads and Full Stack engineers to foster psychological safety, ownership, and high throughput. You Must Have 10+ years in software engineering with 4+ years managing or leading engineering teams delivering enterprise SaaS products. Deep architectural and hands-on grasp of modern full-stack web and mobile stacks (React Native, Angular, Node.js, REST APIs). Practical experience embedding AI development and observability tools (ChatGPT, Cursor.AI, Bolt.AI, Testim, Sentry, LeakCanary, JIRA) into team workflows. Proven track record of high-velocity delivery in Agile/DevOps settings, maintaining 90%+ on-time release predictability across multiple scrum teams. Telemetry and metrics-driven approach: leveraging DORA metrics, defect density, crash-free rates, and automated burndown tracking to guide execution. Strong engineering standards: structured AI-assisted post-mortems, eval/test-driven development, documentation discipline, and production-grade reliability. Exceptional leadership and communication skills with a demonstrated ability to bridge executive strategy and hands-on engineering execution. Nice to Have Experience modernizing enterprise SaaS products with AI features or integrating LLM orchestration into existing full-stack applications. Knowledge of industrial enterprise workflows (EAM, ERP integrations like SAP/Maximo) or field operation platforms. Cloud cost optimization and performance tuning for high-concurrency Node.js and mobile/web client architectures. Experience with MongoDB, event-driven architectures, or change-stream based data flows. Tech Stack & Tools Frontend: React Native, Angular, TypeScript, HTML5/CSS3 Backend: Node.js, RESTful APIs, Microservices architecture Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, MongoDB, SQL AI & Execution: Cursor.AI, Bolt.AI, ChatGPT, Testim Observability & Ops: Sentry, LeakCanary, JIRA, SonarQube Compensation & Growth Reports to Director of Engineering Operations. Path to Sr. EM or platform leadership as full-stack velocity and AI integration scale horizontally across products. What We Offer Competitive compensation and equity tied to measurable impact on release predictability, quality, and performance. A platform to shape the core engineering delivery layer of a category-defining industrial SaaS company. Access to cutting-edge AI, full-stack, and observability toolchains for continuous learning and innovation. Innovapptive does not accept and will not review unsolicited resumes from search firms. title: 26-2236: GIS Architect
description: GIS Architect Job ID#: 26-2236 Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Working hours: Traditional (9-to-5, Mon–Fri) Who We Are: Since our inception back in 2006, Navitas has grown to be an industry leader in the digital transformation space, and we’ve served as trusted advisors supporting our client base within the commercial, federal, and state and local markets. What We Do: At our very core, we’re a group of problem solvers providing our award-winning technology solutions to drive digital acceleration for our customers! With proven solutions, award-winning technologies, and a team of expert problem solvers, Navitas has consistently empowered customers to use technology as a competitive advantage and deliver cutting-edge transformative solutions. About the role: Job Description The GIS Architect defines and governs end-to-end geospatial architecture across Navitas engagements. You will design spatial data models, ingestion and quality pipelines, map services and APIs, and the standards that delivery teams follow. You will be the senior technical authority on spatial matters for clients, partners, and internal teams, and you will help shape the geospatial roadmap and solution offerings of the practice. Core competencies Systems thinking across spatial, transactional, and workflow layers Data quality discipline: topology, accuracy, lineage, reconciliation Clear technical writing (standards, specifications, architecture decision records) Client and partner stakeholder management, escalation handling Mentoring and building geospatial engineering capability in delivery teams Responsibilities: Define target geospatial architectures for client programs: spatial data models, spatial database design (PostGIS / Oracle Spatial), map services, ETL, and integration layers with enterprise and transactional systems. Architect data-ingestion pipelines for survey, drone / aerial imagery, satellite, sensor, and legacy scanned-map inputs, including orthophoto handling and vectorization. Establish topology rules, coordinate reference systems and projections, accuracy thresholds, and QA/QC gates for spatial data. Design map-service and API layers (OGC WMS / WFS / WMTS, vector tiles, REST) for web portals, mobile apps, dashboards, and analytics platforms. Plan for scale: hundreds of millions of features, concurrent multi-tenant loads, high-availability deployment on cloud or on-prem infrastructure. Design reconciliation and exception workflows where spatial data must stay consistent with non-spatial business records. Author and maintain Navitas geospatial standards, data-exchange specifications, and metadata standards; align to OGC, ISO 19100 series, and client-specific mandates. Define data-security, access-control, audit, and data-residency requirements for spatial data. Review and approve solution designs from delivery teams and partners; run architecture review boards. Lead GIS developers, spatial DBAs, survey / photogrammetry specialists, and data engineers; set technical direction and review deliverables. Engage client stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve technical escalations, and present architecture to senior leadership. Drive migration of legacy spatial datasets into modern, governed data platforms. Define the practice technology roadmap: open-source stack adoption (PostGIS, GeoServer, QGIS, MapLibre), cloud-native GIS, AI / ML for automated feature extraction, 3D and drone-data readiness. Support pre-sales: solution proposals, SOW and RFP responses, effort estimation, and technical demos. Must-have skills: GIS experience — 12 years GIS / geospatial architect experience on large-scale programs — 5 years Demonstrated experience delivering enterprise or public-sector geospatial platforms (land, utilities, infrastructure, urban planning, natural resources, or comparable domains) Deep expertise in spatial databases (PostGIS and / or Oracle Spatial), spatial SQL, topology, and performance tuning at tens-of-millions-of-features scale Strong command of the open-source geospatial stack: GeoServer / MapServer, QGIS, GDAL / OGR, GeoTools, OpenLayers / Leaflet / MapLibre, vector tiles Working knowledge of Esri ArcGIS Enterprise / ArcGIS Server and the trade-offs versus open-source options Solid understanding of survey concepts: coordinate systems and datums, projections, DGPS / GNSS, orthophoto and DEM handling, positional accuracy standards Experience designing OGC-compliant services and REST APIs, and integrating GIS with transactional systems (Java / Spring or Python-based back ends) Experience with enterprise deployment: Linux, containers (Docker / Kubernetes), cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP or government cloud), HA and DR design Proven stakeholder management and the ability to present architecture to executive-level audiences Good to have: Experience with drone / aerial-survey data pipelines and automated feature extraction using AI / ML Exposure to data-lake / analytics platforms (Spark, Airflow, cloud data warehouses) for spatial analytics and dashboards Experience with 3D GIS, digital twins, or real-time location data streams Contributions to open-source geospatial projects or published standards work The salary range listed reflects our standard market pay structure. Final compensation will be determined based on multiple factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s unique qualifications, skills required for the position, professional experience, education, and business needs, at the time of hire.
